depiction.primary_object: bold blocky dollar sign with vertical ticks

readings.meaning: payment confirmation, bill paid, or settling a payment
approving an expense, invoice, or budget
verifying a financial transaction, refund, or account balance

ambiguity: In a to-do list where tasks already have completion checkboxes, the checkmark on the icon can blur whether the icon means 'pay' in general or specifically 'confirm/approve payment'.
task_intents: pay a recurring utility or bill

example_tasks.task: Verify that the $450 security deposit from the old landlord hit checking
Sign off on Sarah's travel reimbursement in Expensify before payroll cutoff
Pay the overdue water and sewer bill before the late fee kicks in
Make sure the double charge from the hotel in Chicago was reversed
Send final 50% balance to the wedding photographer via bank transfer
Reconcile September credit card statement against paper receipts
Pay annual HOA assessment online to avoid the $25 paper processing charge
Double-check that the dental insurance claim actually paid out to the clinic so they stop billing us
Approve the final catering deposit for the off-site workshop once finance gives the green light
Confirm the international wire to the supplier in Shenzhen arrived without intermediary bank deductions

example_tasks_es: Comprobar que ya entró la devolución de Hacienda en la cuenta
Pagar el recibo trimestral de la comunidad de vecinos
Aprobar las notas de gastos del equipo comercial antes del viernes
example_tasks_ru: Оплатить квитанцию за капремонт и электричество до 10 числа
Проверить возврат денег за отменённый билет на карту

context_tasks.task: Call clinic billing department about the $180 lab copay
Download PDF receipts for all paid software subscriptions
Email landlord the screenshot of the rent transfer
Update spreadsheet with paid wedding vendor invoices

near_misses.task: Buy a cheap $15 HDMI cable for the bedroom monitor
Check out the new thrift store on 5th Avenue
Write a paper check for the passport renewal application
Cancel the $12/month streaming subscription before trial ends
near_misses.better: dollar sign with slash or cancel badge

near_misses.task: Order new contactless debit card from the bank

reasoning: A dollar sign paired with a checkmark clearly communicates paying a bill, approving an expense, or verifying that a payment went through. These are among the most common recurring tasks in personal finance and workplace admin. It is distinct from a plain dollar sign by emphasizing verification, approval, or settlement.
